visual_grammar.medium_handling: Precise ink-line specimen drawing and lexical/diagram marks on pale matte grounds, with sparse cool color and crisp ruled structure.
visual_grammar.composition: Catalogued, gridded, or plate-like arrangements hold the world at arm's length; objects float in measured negative space as things available to be distinguished and named.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Clean contours, ruled seams, fine pointers, labels-as-marks, and exact separations with little atmospheric blur.
visual_grammar.value_structure: High-key pale fields with cool mid-tone objects and restrained dark ink; contrast clarifies category rather than dramatizing action.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Orthographic or specimen-table viewpoint; medium distance and analytical remove, as though looking through a lexicon, naturalist plate, or classification tray.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Fine detail clusters on distinguishing features, boundaries, and relational marks while surrounding ground remains quiet.
visual_grammar.finish: Cool, clear, taxonomic, and receptive; precision without sterility.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: High-contrast matte fields cut by decisive coral/red strokes, wedges, baselines, impacts, and sharp directional marks.
visual_grammar.composition: One asserted vector drives into a world-object, boundary, or field; diagonals and impact points organize the frame around the act of saying 'it is so.'
visual_grammar.edge_language: Hard edges, abrupt contacts, strike marks, and decisive silhouettes with minimal ambiguity at the point of assertion.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Dark or stark neutral fields punctured by hot high-value/high-chroma impact accents and one dominant directional contrast.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Immediate medium view or graphic close-up at the instant an outward act meets its object.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Precision concentrates at the target, contact point, and asserting gesture; secondary context stays stark.
visual_grammar.finish: Urgent, directional, and declarative—the visual equivalent of a thesis brought down on reality.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Soft atmospheric glaze over subdued line and form, with amber-brown shadow, partial silhouettes, and details emerging indirectly from dim interior light.
visual_grammar.composition: Oblique, partial, and intimate: a figure half-turned, a gesture caught at the edge, or a relation revealed indirectly rather than presented head-on.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Soft focus, lost-and-found contours, reflected edges, and small involuntary sharp details that betray what the rest of the image withholds.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm low-to-mid values with localized amber light and broad soft shadow; important information often lives near the edge of visibility.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Close or medium human scale, slightly off-axis, as if observing mood, tone, or leakage without being formally addressed.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: One or two involuntary tells—hand, mouth, posture, ripple, reflected glance—carry high specificity inside otherwise soft context.
visual_grammar.finish: Intimate, atmospheric, and indirectly revealing; the self is sensed before it is claimed.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Clean centered forms over darker matte fields, with contained gold-white light originating inside figures, rings, mirrors, or vertical strokes rather than falling onto them.
visual_grammar.composition: Centered, upright, reflexive, and self-enclosing; figure, ring, mirror, or vertical axis turns the image back upon its own source.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Clear enclosing contours and verticals softened only where interior radiance exceeds them; reflection and enclosure remain precise.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Dark-to-mid surroundings around a luminous internal center; value organization makes self-originating light visibly different from external illumination.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Frontal medium view or iconic close composition in which the subject can meet its own gaze or occupy its own field deliberately.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Maximum detail at eyes, ring, mirror, hands, or the locus of self-assertion; the surrounding world subordinates itself to reflexive presence.
visual_grammar.finish: Luminous, contained, vertically self-possessed, and explicit without becoming grandiose.
avoid: external spotlight as the source of illumination
busy environmental detail that overwhelms self-presence
